fields.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
fields.description: Geralt of Rivia, a monster-hunting witcher, searches for his adopted daughter Ciri as the Wild Hunt closes in.

fields.title: Elden Ring
fields.description: An open world dark fantasy shaped by Hidetaka Miyazaki and George R. R. Martin, where the player becomes a Tarnished seeking the Elden Ring.

fields.title: God of War
fields.description: Kratos and his son Atreus journey through the nine realms of Norse mythology.

fields.title: Cyberpunk 2077
fields.description: Mercenary V survives in Night City while carrying the digital engram of rockerboy legend Johnny Silverhand.

fields.title: Baldur's Gate 3
fields.description: A turn-based D&D RPG in which a party infected by mind flayer parasites tries to avoid becoming illithids.

fields.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
fields.description: Arthur Morgan, a member of the Van der Linde gang, lives through the decline of the Wild West era in early 1900s America.

fields.title: Hollow Knight
fields.description: A small bug knight explores the ruined underground kingdom of Hallownest, full of secrets and dangerous creatures.

fields.title: Dark Souls III
fields.description: An Ashen One, risen from the grave, must return the Lords of Cinder to their thrones and stall the fading of the Flame.

fields.title: Grand Theft Auto V
fields.description: Three criminals, Michael, Trevor and Franklin, plan a series of heists in the fictional city of Los Santos.

fields.title: Hades
fields.description: Zagreus, son of Hades, repeatedly tries to escape the Underworld, battling the forces of the Greek gods along the way.
